name: Existing field notes app revision
purpose: Extend the existing offline notes app with reversible backup restore
differentiators: Preserve the existing native integrations and add validated backup restore
acceptance: Existing create, edit and restart persistence tests still pass on the configured Android device
Export notes, delete local data and restore the same notes from the export
Reject a malformed backup without changing existing data; capture actual device screenshots
constraints: Snapshot the source repository and work only inside the returned task workspace, never the original sourceDir
Keep apps/mobile and its android native host, scripts and lockfile; adapt the paired commands to the existing package manager
No ejection, framework migration, hidden features or review bypass
